title.en: Meridional polar position and vector projection
title.zh: 子午面极坐标与矢量正向投影

summary: Map cylindrical meridional position and vector components to r,theta and their orthonormal components.

identity.relation: r=hypot(rho,z); theta=atan2(rho,z); u_r=u_rho sin(theta)+u_z cos(theta); u_theta=u_rho cos(theta)-u_z sin(theta).
identity.definition: theta is radians from +Z toward +rho. The source pi/2+atan2(Z,Rho) gives cos(theta)=-Z/r and conflicts with its inverse. The corrected angle and orthogonal vector basis preserve position, norm and inverse mapping.
identity.model: Euclidean meridional coordinate transformation, no magnetic model.
identity.geometry: Planar signed rho,Z coordinates with positive distance from origin.
identity.coordinates: Caller coherent length/vector units; theta radians.
identity.boundary: Origin has no polar vector basis and rejects; nonzero points on the axis are valid.
assumptions: r>0; no physical field null convention inferred

preconditions: Finite broadcastable real arrays; away from coordinate origin
supported: Axis and signed planar coordinate quadrants

failure_semantics.invalid_input: ValueError for nonfinite input or origin; NumPy broadcasting errors propagate.
failure_semantics.partial_results: No partial tuple on invalid input.

provenance.lineage_summary: Recovered Pleiades analysis/helpers.py meridional transform. D2 corrects forward angle sign against the source inverse and independently derived orthonormal basis. Original projection/roundtrip tolerance3e-15 retained.
provenance.license_status: MIT source retained; final human decision pending.

example.description: Project a vector at a positive-Z axis point.
example.code:
from scirel.geometry.sampling import transform_to_rtheta
r,t,ur,ut=transform_to_rtheta(0.,2.,3.,4.)
assert r==2 and t==0 and ur==4 and ut==3
example.expected: theta0, radial component4 and angular component3.

scope: Independent projection, signed quadrants, norm and inverse roundtrip
verification.evidence_ceiling: Coordinate/vector identity; not physical field qualification.
known_limitations: Length and vector units remain caller supplied
